The round was led by TQ Ventures, SignalFire and Y Combinator, supplemented by several high-profile business angels from the European tech ecosystem. The private investors include Bastian Nominacher (Co-Founder and CEO of Celonis ), Tao Tao (Co-Founder and COO of GetYourGuide ) and Lukas Deutsch
